summary: Completed testing of PhotoUploadChip removal and StudentPhotoSwitch consolidation. All student photo gates now follow ONLY the remaining switch (settings id=student_photo). Backend API correctly enforces photo upload permissions based on enabled/until/allow_replace settings. Frontend admin portal shows StudentPhotoSwitch button with working modal and toggle. PhotoUploadChip component successfully removed from codebase.

Backend: PUT /api/settings/student-photo works for admin/petugas, returns 403 for siswa
Backend: enabled=false -> open=false, blocks siswa photo uploads with 403
Backend: enabled=true -> open=true, allows siswa photo uploads
Backend: until in past -> open=false, blocks siswa uploads with 403
Backend: until in future -> open=true, allows uploads
Backend: Invalid until format returns 400 validation error
Backend: Admin/petugas can always upload photos regardless of settings
Backend: POST /api/members/{id}/photo as siswa blocked when disabled (403)
Backend: POST /api/members/{id}/photo as siswa allowed when enabled (200)
Backend: POST /api/account/photo as siswa blocked when disabled (403)
Frontend Admin: PhotoUploadChip component NOT found on Anggota page (correctly removed)
Frontend Admin: StudentPhotoSwitch button exists with [data-testid=student-photo-switch-button]
